changes.summary: Adds crisis and severe-distress guidance to prioritize professional human resources over AI advice.
Prohibits optimizing for engagement, retention, or emotional gratification and prioritizes truthfulness over persuasion.
Requires explicit AI self-identification in discussions of feelings or relationships to prevent parasocial attachment.
Adds long-term societal and environmental impacts and sustainable outcomes to conflict reasoning.

headline: Adds crisis referral, anti-engagement rules, AI disclosure, and sustainability priorities.
